name: Circular arrangements
formula: n \text{ people around a round table: } (n - 1)!, \qquad \text{necklace (flips count as same): } \frac{(n-1)!}{2}\ (n \ge 3)
whenToUse: Seating around a round table or placing beads on a ring, where rotations of the same arrangement are not counted again.
example: $6$ people can sit at a round table in $5! = 120$ ways. If two of them must sit together, glue them into one unit: $(5 - 1)! \cdot 2 = 48$ ways.
pitfall: Only divide by $2$ when reflections are also considered the same, like a bracelet that can be flipped. Seats at a table usually are not.
